unit.why: A narrative episode in which R. Leib Janowitzer, sent by the Rav (Alter Rebbe), poses as a non-Hasid in Vilna to spy on the Gaon's circle during the Rav's imprisonment.
unit.boundary_note: Opens with 'עתה נחזור', resuming the larger imprisonment narrative; ends at the Gaon's convening of an assembly, so the story continues into the next division.

stories.start_quote: עתה נחזור לספר את אשר קרה
stories.end_quote: וע"כ אסף אסיפה להועץ מה לעשות
stories.summary_en: During the Alter Rebbe's imprisonment, his hasid R. Leib Janowitzer disguises himself as a poor non-Hasid. He changes even his tefillin knot, lodges at the Vilna Gaon's table and reports to the Hasidim in Petersburg on the mitnagdim's plotting. He then learns that the Rav's written defence, translated for the Kaiser, will likely free him.
